title: 第五十一章 山地精与熊人族上第五十五章 异怪
lines: 西隆行走在自己的意识星空里，鳞片上流光掠影，变幻莫测。
距他第一次开启秘藏，已经过了五年，五年时光缓缓而过，如今的铬龙不再是当初的幼崽，意识星空里的景象，也已经大不相同。
莫奇和因塔斯的投影明亮，羁绊之丝十分坚韧，这是西隆最亲密的同伴，坚定的支持者，即使因塔斯去了红堡，西隆也不担心他们的关系会因此疏远。
反倒是鸣雷龙，在分别之前一直忧心忡忡，显得十分不安。
就像因塔斯说的那样，分别之后，幼龙之间便有了不同的身份，地位不一样了，次龙是红堡里的魔法学徒，即便学有所成，也只能担任家族的巡猎者，奉行家族的命令在失落荒野中行走，处理各种内部事务、强化家族的统治，相当于高级督军。
而重质龙作为开拓者，将会奔赴各个边境，进行开荒扩张和收复失地运动，即使是在巨龙领主的管辖之下，也会拥有极大的权力，如果头上没有大龙，幼龙所开拓的土地就完全归自己所有，还可以培养眷属、掌握军队，跟家族里的大龙领主没有任何区别。
高级督军和巨龙领主，身份当然是天差地别，也难怪因塔斯觉得不安，十分担心西隆会将他抛下，由此甚至产生了干脆不去红堡、追随在西隆身边的想法。
结果当然是被西隆严厉否决。
事关鸣雷龙的未来成长，他不可能这样安排，即便这会使自己身边多出一个帮手，西隆也不愿因小失大，只是约定等因塔斯离开红堡之后再汇合。
克莱利、余焰、棘砾。
这是秘藏开启时不曾出现的投影，作为一起从雏龙玩到幼龙时期的伙伴，他们的羁绊之丝虽然没有莫奇那样强韧，但也同样坚定。
克莱利和西隆一起夺过食、挨过揍，群龙推翻拉顿之后，他们还是经常凑在一块玩，西隆向克莱利请教发射鳞片的技法，应用在自己骨锥上，动不动交手一阵。
克莱利是极其聪明的，只是比较懒散，不愿意背负太多重担，而西隆则恰恰相反，所以他们后来相处得越来越融洽，加上钴蓝霸主实力强劲，即使当初克莱利不主动开口，西隆也会想尽办法把他拉到自己的队伍里。
另外两条雌龙，相比对待棘砾的从容亲切，西隆这个家伙，自从吃过一次羽龙狩猎的食物之后，动不动就往余焰的巢穴里钻，说是交流冥想心得，实在是劳苦功高。
值得一提的是，余焰在第二年的时候，真的就掌握了冥想，当初吞服魔药的五条雏龙里，只有她和西隆做到了这一步，在走出赭石谷的时候，羽龙竟然也成了五级灾害，和希多里维之流的优秀者并列。
喂哺者曾经说过，赭石谷里有许多出众的小龙，譬如西隆、杰利里昂、克莱利，如果把他们的出众归因于至尊血谕“遗火燎原”的影响，那么余焰的出众，就完全只能用纯粹的天赋异禀来形容了。
西隆绕着余焰的投影打量，走着走着，脚步忽然一顿，看到前方流光溢彩，光芒汇聚，勾勒出两道全新的投影。
一道是意料之内的镍龙比多，投影微小，和莫奇相近，另一道投影则极其惊人，竟然比钴蓝霸主克莱利还要庞大许多。
拉顿。
即使仅仅是一道映照而出的投影，拉顿也依旧目光如炬、气势磅礴，说是幼龙，倒是更像巨龙之王的幼年体。
一条极微弱的羁绊之丝，将他和西隆连接起来。
西隆有些意外，他原以为拉顿只是将自己当做一个竞争对手，或者是夺走喂哺者偏爱的敌人，没想到竟然能够得到他的认同，出现在自己的命运星空里。
不过，拉顿也没什么朋友就是了，幼龙们在离开赭石谷时各自结伴，拉顿却选择独自前往钢脊平原，一头扎进了家族对血岭诸部的战争中。
应该会很孤独吧？
西隆收回目光，钢脊平原距离风吟台地并不很远，那里是家族最大的牧场，也囤积着家族一半以上的兵力，灰烬要塞每日吞吐着巨量的物资和人口，冷峻凝视着血岭诸部的强敌。
有机会的话，西隆也想去看一看。
不过在此之前，他必须要先开创出自己的事业，因为拉顿的出现，群星铭刻的充能即将满溢，接下来只要能够获得一支眷属的诚心追随，西隆就可以发动第二次群星铭刻。
他万分期待。
一阵沙沙的动静打断西隆思绪，他退出意识星空，睁开竖眼，看见一队山地精缓慢、谨慎的走近，一直到了幼龙近前。
“山地精向您觐见，真龙大人。”
他们走到克莱利面前，躬身行礼，默认这条最大的幼龙是为头领：“我们是居住在台地西部的蛮骨氏族，世代向烬痕家族效忠，追随烬痕家族的战旗。”
克莱利揣出爪子站起来，刚想说话，就听到湖畔传来一阵涉水声，西隆召来莫奇和比多，纷纷站到自己身后。
他眼神微微一动，当即不再转身回头，而是拿出了钴蓝霸主的架势，昂首俯视。
“地精，说你的名字。”
克莱利用通用语开口。
“亚兹，亚兹·蛮骨，真龙大人。”领头的山地精说。
克莱利学着铁龙的腔调：“你们前来觐见，却不带着礼物和诚意，这样冒犯我们，是有什么要说？”
“这是一块贫瘠的土地，蛮骨氏族穷困潦倒，如果我们带着兽皮和兽骨前来觐见，反倒妨碍真龙的眼睛，因此我们带来的是敬畏、拥护和忠诚。”
亚兹缓缓说到：“如果真龙大人有什么需要，请向我们下令，蛮骨氏族能够做到的，不会推脱。”
几条幼龙各自散开，绕着周围踱步，缓缓打量着山地精，亚兹感受到了那种审视的目光，神情不变。
“我们所需要的，就是这片土地本身，你们献上了拥护和忠诚，这样很好，但还不够好，你应当举着氏族的仪仗，将我们请进营地，烹牛宰羊、奉上最好的宝物招待，让我巡视你们的族群。”
这番话强硬又直白，克莱利发现自己好像更适合当铁龙了，反正他一身鳞片紫的发黑，诸族基本都认不出来。
content_en:
Shillong walked in the starry sky of his own consciousness, and the light on his scales was unpredictable.
Five years have passed since he first opened the secret treasure. Five years have passed slowly. Today's Chromium Dragon is no longer the cub it was before, and the scene in the starry sky of consciousness is also very different.
The projections of Mochi and Intas are bright, and the bonding thread is very tenacious. They are Shillong's closest companions and staunch supporters. Even if Intas goes to the Red Fort, Shillong is not worried that their relationship will be alienated.
On the contrary, Thunder Dragon had been worried before the separation and seemed very uneasy.
Just like what Intas said, after the separation, the young dragons have different identities and statuses. Cilong is a magic apprentice in the Red Castle. Even if he is successful in learning, he can only serve as the family's ranger. He follows the family's orders and walks in the Lost Wilderness, handles various internal affairs, strengthens the family's rule, and is equivalent to a senior governor.
As pioneers, heavy dragons will go to various borders to expand and recover lost lands. Even under the jurisdiction of a dragon lord, they will have great power. If there is no dragon above them, the land developed by the young dragon will be completely owned by them. They can also cultivate their dependents and control the army, no different from the dragon lords in the family.
The identities of the senior warlord and the dragon lord are of course very different. No wonder Intas felt uneasy and worried that Shillong would leave him behind. From this, he even came up with the idea of ​​not going to the Red Castle at all and following Shillong.
The result was of course severely rejected by Shillong.
Regarding the future growth of the Thunder Dragon, it was impossible for him to arrange it like this. Even if it would bring an extra helper to his side, Shillong was not willing to lose a small thing and just agreed to wait until Intas left the Red Fort before reuniting.
Clary, Ember, and Thorns.
This is a projection that never appeared when the secret was opened. As partners who grew up playing together from young dragons to young dragons, their bonding thread is not as strong as Moqi's, but it is equally firm.
Clery and Shillong took food and received beatings together. After the dragons overthrew Laton, they still often played together. Shillong asked Clery for tips on how to shoot scales, and applied them to his own bone awl, and they kept fighting for a while.
Clery is extremely smart, but lazy and unwilling to bear too many burdens, while Shillong is just the opposite, so they get along more and more harmoniously. In addition, the Cobalt Blue Overlord is strong, even if Clery does not take the initiative to speak, Shillong will try his best to bring him into his team.
Compared to the other two female dragons, who treated Thorny Gravel calmly and kindly, Shillong, ever since he ate the food hunted by a feathered dragon, has been burrowing into Yuyan's lair at every turn to exchange meditation experiences. It's really a great achievement for his hard work.
It is worth mentioning that Yu Yan really mastered meditation in her second year. Among the five young dragons who swallowed the magic potion, she and Shillong were the only ones to achieve this step. When they walked out of the Ocher Valley, the Yulong also became a level five disaster, ranking alongside the outstanding ones like Hedo Rivi.
The Feeder once said that there are many outstanding little dragons in the Ocher Valley, such as Shillong, Jelilion, and Clary. If their excellence is attributed to the influence of the supreme blood oracle "The Remaining Fire Starts the Prairie", then Yu Yan's excellence can only be described as pure talent.
Shillong looked around the projection of Yu Yan. As he walked, his footsteps suddenly stopped and he saw a bright light ahead. The light converged and outlined two new projections.
One is the expected Nickel Dragon Bido, with a tiny projection, similar to Mochi. The other projection is extremely astonishing, and is actually much larger than the cobalt blue overlord Clary.
Raton.
Even if it is just a reflected projection, Raton still has a bright gaze and majestic momentum. Although he is a young dragon, he is more like the young body of the Dragon King.
A very weak thread of bond connected him to Shillong.
Shillong was a little surprised. He originally thought that Raton only regarded him as a competitor, or an enemy who took away the Feeder's preference, but he didn't expect that he would be recognized by him and appear in the starry sky of his destiny.
However, Rodon didn't have many friends. The young dragons formed separate groups when they left Ocher Valley, but Rodon chose to go to the Steel Ridge Plains alone and plunged into the family's war against the tribes of the Blood Ridge.
It must be lonely, right?
Shillong withdrew his gaze. The Steel Spine Plains were not very far from the Wind Song Terrace. It was the family's largest ranch and housed more than half of the family's troops. The Ashes Fortress handled a huge amount of supplies and people every day, and stared coldly at the powerful enemies of the Blood Ridge tribes.
If I have a chance, Shillong would also like to take a look.
But before that, he must first create his own business. Because of the appearance of Raton, the energy of the Stars' Engraving is about to be overflowed. As long as he can get a family to follow him sincerely, Shillong can launch the second Stars' Engraving.
He was looking forward to it.
A burst of rustling movement interrupted Shillong's thoughts. He exited the starry sky of consciousness, opened his vertical eyes, and saw a group of mountain goblins approaching slowly and cautiously until they were in front of the young dragon.
"The mountain goblins come to see you, Lord True Dragon."
They walked up to Clery and bowed, acknowledging that the largest young dragon was the leader: "We are the Barbarian Bone Clan living in the western part of the platform. We have been loyal to the Ember Mark Family for generations and follow the Ember Mark Family's battle flag."
Clary took out his paws and stood up. Just when he was about to speak, he heard the sound of wading from the lakeside. Shillong summoned Mochi and Bido to stand behind him.
His eyes moved slightly, and he immediately stopped turning around. Instead, he took on the posture of a cobalt blue overlord and looked down.
"Goblin, say your name."
Clary spoke in Common.
"Yaz, Yaz Savage Bones, Lord True Dragon." said the leading mountain goblin.
Clary imitated Tie Long's accent: "You came to see me without any gifts or sincerity, and you offended us like this. What do you have to say?"
"This is a barren land, and the Barbarian Bone Clan is impoverished. If we bring animal skins and bones to the audience, it will hinder the true dragon's eyes. Therefore, what we bring is awe, support and loyalty."
Yaz said slowly: "If Lord True Dragon needs anything, please give us an order. The Barbarian Bone Clan can do it without shirk."
Several young dragons dispersed and walked around, slowly looking at the mountain goblins. Yaz felt the scrutinizing eyes, and his expression remained unchanged.
"What we need is the land itself. You offer your support and loyalty. This is good, but it is not good enough. You should hold up the clan's guard of honor, invite us into the camp, cook cattle and slaughter sheep, offer the best treasures to entertain, and let me inspect your clan."
These words were tough and straightforward. Clary found that he seemed to be more suitable to be an iron dragon. Anyway, his scales were purple and black, and all the tribes basically couldn't recognize him.
